data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's prior-year reserve movement for pre-2022 years was a small net release, driven by favourable development on the 2021 underwriting year as evidenced by the gross claims development table. This movement appears to reflect favourable development/IBNR recalibration and the impact of reinsurance recoveries, with inflation and catastrophe exposure noted as ongoing reserving considerations.
raw_causal_phrases: Inflation assumptions are included within the SIAB's reserving processes to cover all forms of inflation, which will increase future claims payments.
An element of IBNR also relates to specific large losses, such as catastrophe events.
Reserve adequacy is monitored through quarterly review by the Asta Actuarial team and the Management Committee.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (gross claims outstanding 461 $'000 at 1 Jan 2023). No explicit 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross figure was located in narrative notes; prior-year development was therefore derived from the gross claims development table (gross triangle). Triangle formatting/OCR appears irregular; numbers used are those printed in the gross claims development table (units $'000) and converted to millions. No specific named prior-year events quantified. If a direct gross prior-year movement note exists elsewhere in the full report, it was not found in the provided excerpts.
